candidates.counterexample: A caller holding a validated or canonical identifier as `string` can no longer pass it to `memberCacheKey`; the narrowed parameter type causes a TypeScript error despite unchanged runtime behavior.
candidates.evidenceNeeded: Inspect immediate callers and the project typecheck/API contract to confirm whether all callers already use parseMemberId and whether this narrowing is intentional.

clear.reason: No authorization decision or tenant-isolation behavior changed; tenantId remains part of the same length-prefixed cache key.
Runtime trimming, uppercasing, validation, and cache-key construction are unchanged; the diff is type-level.

escalations.reason: The shell sandbox blocked reading the mandated breadth-worker packet and inspecting immediate callers; validate the compatibility candidate against the caller surface and typecheck.
